correctness.rationale: On finitely supported sequences the r-fold commutator of M_H with C has matrix k_r(i,j)=(H_i-H_j)^r/i for i>=j (r=0 convention). Sorting the r ordered harmonic increments bounds it coefficientwise by r! C^(r+1); Hardy’s sharp ℓ^p norm yields ≤r! (p/(p-1))^(r+1). For fixed lower-tail cutoff m, truncated vectors j^(-1/p) on [m,N] yield asymptotic pointwise ratio by a logarithmic Riemann-sum gamma integral r!/(1-1/p)^(r+1), and harmonic sums yield sharp tail operator norm. For compact B, BQ_m->0 via uniform convergence of Q_m* on compact B* unit-ball image, so essential norm equals this sharp norm. Coefficient norms imply Taylor radius (p-1)/p. Independent Fraction computations verified 7x7 matrices and coefficient domination through r=4; finite tests do not imply infinite-dimensional norm.
residual_risks: Only 1<p<infinity and nonnegative integer commutator orders; multiplication M_H is unbounded, so domain is finite-support core with bounded extension of its formal commutators. No endpoint assertion.
